<!-- Describe your idea in detail. How should it work, conceptually? -->

<!-- Any other approaches, packages, or designs you considered — and why you rejected them. -->

## 🚦 Impact

- [ ] Small quality-of-life tweak

- [ ] New major capability (e.g. blog, CMS, admin panel)

## 📝 Additional Context

<!-- Add any other context, links, or references here. -->

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched for similar open and closed issues and found no duplicates.
- [ ] I have explained why this feature belongs in this project (as opposed to a separate package or fork).
- [ ] I would be willing to implement this feature myself and open a PR.
